project: Wuxia Life P46 Minimum Playable Life Samples Roadmap
description: Plan the next post-P45 direction by converting proven shaping mechanics into three 0-40 minimum playable life samples through a staged roadmap covering only story configuration, lightweight player-facing expression, and validation surfaces.

userStories.title: Define the three-line scope contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an explicit scope contract for the three minimum playable life samples so later work does not expand back into full-system rebuilding.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit scope to orthodox martial, demonic edge, and merchant rise 0-40 life samples
Allow only story configuration, lightweight display fill, and validation script work in this phase family
Mark runtime platformization, full-route coverage, and whole-pool expansion as out of scope
Record the scope contract in the roadmap PRD

userStories.title: Split the roadmap into executable stages
userStories.description: As a planner, I want the roadmap decomposed into multiple implementation-ready phases so execution can proceed in bounded iterations instead of one oversized wave.
acceptanceCriteria: Split the roadmap into three stage PRDs
Give each stage its own goals, non-goals, stories, and acceptance methods
Ensure each stage can be approved and closed independently
Document the dependency order between stages

userStories.title: Define the shared sample-line quality bar
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one shared quality bar for all three sample lines so stage-level work does not drift into inconsistent definitions of minimum playable.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the minimum requirements for key nodes, key choices, cost fallback, midlife identity signal, and age-40 summary
Define a shared acceptance bar reusable by later stages
State that gate pass is not the only acceptance source
Record the quality bar in the roadmap PRD
userStories.notes: Shared guardrail story. quality bar section added in PRD §10

userStories.title: Define phase handoff rules
userStories.description: As a planner, I want explicit phase handoff rules so later sessions know when to move from configuration to display and then to validation.
acceptanceCriteria: State that phase one closes before broad display work begins
State that phase two closes before claiming the samples are player-readable
State that phase three must include simulation evidence and a human checklist
Record the handoff rules in the roadmap PRD
userStories.notes: Execution-order story. handoff rules section added in PRD §11
